description: This file defines the 'RideBottomSheet' widget for a Flutter app, which displays ride details such as distance, fare, and options for coupons and payment methods, along with a button to request a ride.

classes.name: RideBottomSheet
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays ride details (distance, fare), options like coupons and payment methods, and a button to request a ride.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the bottom sheet, using Consumer to listen to RideState and display dynamic information.

methods.name: _showPaymentMethod
methods.description: Shows a modal bottom sheet for selecting payment methods.

methods.name: _onRequestRide
methods.description: Triggers the ride request process, shows a confirmation SnackBar, and dismisses the bottom sheet.
